shellCommands.command: cat package.json; ls; git status --short; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50; cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
cat lib/projects.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx; git diff; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
grep -rl "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs | head; grep -rn "cacheLife\b\|'use cache'" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md | head -20

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Ada; team=Core' -H 'x-region: eu-west' localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Welcome, [^<]*\|Team: [^<]*\|Region: [^<]*\|[0-9]* active projects\|Ada\|eu-west' | sort | uniq -c; pkill -f "next start" ; true

for c in 'member=Ada; team=Core|eu-west' 'member=Bo; team=Ops|us-east'; do curl -s -H "Cookie: ${c%|*}" -H "x-region: ${c#*|}" localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Welcome, [^<]*\|Team: [^<]*\|Region: [^<]*\|[0-9]* active projects\|Ada\|Bo\b\|eu-west\|us-east' | sort -u | tr '\n' ';'; echo; done
